question: A line passes through the points (x,2) and (3,-4) and has a slope of 2. What is the value of x?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **slope (m)** is the ratio of the change in y-coordinates to the change in x-coordinates: **m = Δy / Δx**.

Given **m = 2**, **Δy = 2 − (−4) = 6**, and **Δx = x − 3**.

⇒ 2 = 6 / (x − 3)

⇒ x − 3 = 6 / 2 = 3

⇒ x = 3 + 3 = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Point 1: **(x₁, y₁) = (x, 2)**

Point 2: **(x₂, y₂) = (3, −4)**

Slope: **m = 2**

**Formula Used:**

The slope of a line passing through (x₁, y₁) and (x₂, y₂) is: **m = (y₂ − y₁) / (x₂ − x₁)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e31759d3492faaa0119d0f7645426aa9fd2ee0f72886cfdb166392bce014d82.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ m = (y₂ − y₁) / (x₂ − x₁)

⇒ 2 = (−4 − 2) / (3 − x)

⇒ 2 = −6 / (3 − x)

⇒ 2 × (3 − x) = −6

⇒ 6 − 2x = −6

⇒ −2x = −6 − 6

⇒ −2x = −12

⇒ x = −12 / −2

⇒ x = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Slope-Intercept Form

The equation of a line can be written as **y = mx + c**, where **m** is the slope and **c** is the y-intercept.

Parallel and Perpendicular Lines

Two lines are **parallel** if their slopes are equal (m₁ = m₂) and **perpendicular** if the product of their slopes is −1 (m₁ × m₂ = −1).

Point-Slope Form

The equation of a line passing through (x₁, y₁) with slope **m** is given by **y − y₁ = m(x − x₁)**.</p
